text:
Sam (People Ops): Heads-up team — executive asks landed: were moving the annual privacy attestation and SOC2 evidence intake up by 4 days. New hard cut: Fri 03/19 18:00 PT for uploads. Please read the checklist + required naming below.

Priya (Security): Can we get a short list of the must-have artifacts by control family? Last round had some missing items and it slowed reviewers.

Sam (People Ops): Yes. Quick checklist (high priority controls):
- Access reviews (user/group exports or screenshots)
- Change management (PR links + deployment log)
- Vendor assessments (signed questionnaires or procurement emails)
- Encryption/KMS exports (audit trail)
- Incident response tabletop notes (date + attendees)
Upload these to the central uploader and tag the control id. Upload form: https://go.redwood.company/evidence-upload-form

Diego (Infra): For change management, do you want a link to the GitHub PR + the CD deploy log? Or a single combined PDF?

Priya (Security): Both links are fine. If you zip them, include a README.txt listing links and dates. Filename convention MUST be followed so automation can ingest it.

Sam (People Ops): Filename pattern: <YYYYMMDD>_<team>_<control>.<ext> e.g. 20260319_infra_change_mgmt.zip. Exact underscores please.

Hannah (Legal): Vendor questionnaires: procurement has a backlog. If procurement cannot sign off by the cut, will an email thread stating status + estimated delivery work as interim evidence?

Priya (Security): Yes, provisional vendor status email threads are acceptable if they include: vendor name, request date, expected completion, and owner. Mark them as "provisional" in the upload form and follow up with final docs within 10 business days.

Tess (Eng): Quick Q on screenshots: some dashboards show relative timestamps (e.g., "2 days ago"). Do we need absolute timestamps?

Priya (Security): Absolute timestamps are required. If the dashboard only shows relative, take a terminal export or include the query + the run time in a short README.

compliance_bot: Reminder queued: "Attestation intake due Fri 03/19 18:00 PT". Will post in #people-ops and DM team owners at 12:00 PT on due date.

Sam (People Ops): Office hours this week for evidence triage: Wed 11:00-13:00 PT, Thu 16:00-17:30 PT. Calendar & Zoom link are in the compliance doc. If you need 1:1 help, book a slot on my calendar.

Diego (Infra): Noted — planning to produce infra bundle Thu morning. Will include KMS export and deploy logs.

Hannah (Legal): Will coordinate procurement and upload provisional vendor packets where needed.

Tess (Eng): I'll convert dashboard exports into CSV + README and drop in the uploader.

Sam (People Ops): Thank you. Two small process items: 1) if you are a cross-team owner, please notify downstream teams in the "owner" field in the upload form; 2) mismatched filenames will be auto-rejected by the ingestion script and will require manual re-upload.

Priya (Security): Also, redact any PII from screenshots; if redactions are applied, include a short note describing redacted fields.

Sam (People Ops): Final note: exceptions will be handled but will add review time. Please aim to hit the deadline. Ping #compliance-help or DM me if stuck. :raised_hands:
